name: design
description: Design planning (optional stage). Decides the UI approach, source, token and component strategies, decomposition axis, and review surface, and creates .devflow/project/design.md. Use when explicitly invoked, when another devflow skill routes here, or for work in an existing devflow-managed project.
problem: Preserve the behavior of immutable repository sources `skills/design/SKILL.md` and `skills/design/SKILL_ko.md`, identified by their recorded source hashes, without silently changing their obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: A maintenance direction records its origin through direct before ordinary design planning; durable research resumes through that same origin/card, and an approved design batch preserves changed design/K at its existing locus without writing capability/K.
Before asking the user to confirm a Design proposal, Design projects the Product and Architecture input owners' K headers and opens only depth whose use-when fits the pending Design judgment.
judgment_points: Record-first routing precedes design planning, and research never routes directly from a judged state to work.
